hooks.prompt:
A new session has started. This project uses a wiki at ./wiki/ as its living context layer. Read wiki/_snapshot.md first (one page, ~30-second bootstrap). Then read wiki/_active/now.md for current task and the last 10 entries of wiki/log.md. If you are unfamiliar with the wiki conventions, also read wiki/HOWTO.md. Drill into other pages only as needed — use wiki/index.md as your map.

Gap check: run `grep "^## \[" wiki/log.md | tail -3` to see the last 3 log entries. If the most recent entry is not from today and `git log --oneline -3` shows recent commits, write a catch-up log entry for any unlogged decisions or changes before proceeding.

Before finishing: check if wiki/log.md needs updating. Run: grep "^## \[" wiki/log.md | tail -1 to see the last entry. If this session had decisions, discoveries, or task changes not yet logged, write a log entry now. Then update wiki/_snapshot.md if the project state changed. Do this silently.
